items.text: Tudo em perfeito estado , sr. José  Augusto  sempre solicito , a disposição  , educado , me senti em casa . Recomendo a todos , e estarei retornando a acomodação  em breve . Obrigado,  William
Great location, very friendly & responsive, and a short walk to the beach and downtown. They even had snorkeling gear to use. I was very happy with my stay, thank you so much for hosting us!

I'm not sure how 95 a night turned into 360 but it is worth 95. Definitely not worth 360. The positives here is a covered hot tub, well lit with convenient towels, hanging space, and table. The floors and linens and beds and bathroom was nice and clean. I didn't realize there was no tv which would have been nice as well as no chargers. No kitchen, dirty cups, and just awkward space to try to eat or even just prepare drinks. I was surprised there wasn't a sink besides in the bathroom and no coffee for guest use which just seems like it would have been an easy accommodation to add to the stay. Again, it is a nice space and the hosts are friendly and helpful and timely. I just didn't read or notice all the details about the kitchen being in the main house with the family.
Was an amazing experience! The place was extremely clean and easy to find. The beds were very comfortable. Highly recommended.

If you're looking for somewhere to stay in Naples that is close to the ferry and train station look no further! We stayed in this Airbnb for a night in Naples and it was perfect for what we needed. The building itself was dirty (cigarettes in the stairway) and the elevator was broken, but the apartment itself was clean and comfortable. The hosts were particularly helpful and welcoming.

Four of us stayed in the main Ohana house. The home was very clean and fully supplied with anything you need in the kitchen, bathrooms and common areas.  Apple TV with Netflix is here for your entertainment.  Free WiFi was flawless. All bedding and towels are included including beach towels. The property is beautiful and well maintained by Paul and the staff.  Parking is very convenient.  Beach chairs, coolers, snorkel gear are all available for use. Two kayaks with paddles and life jackets are included.  Some of us rode the bikes along the beach directly across the main road.  We grilled on the gas grill one evening with friends visiting from Poipu. The grill was perfect. The free washer and dryer was a great add on. This location was convenient for us and allowed easy travel in either direction to visit the area up to Hanalei in one direction and Poipu in the other. Don't miss Moloa'a beach on the way to Hanalei where Gilligan's Island was filmed in the 60's. Kapaa has some nice locally owned restaurants and we loved the laid back feel of the area. Easy access to grocery stores for food, wine and local beer. Phone service with Verizon in this area was a bit sketchy but was OK. We

A wonderful,hidden capsule in the heartof the city with easy walk-in access to many local attractions including the ruin bars. Gabi was fantastic, offering advise on transfers and proactive in ensuring our stay went as smoothly as possible. We will 1000% be returning. Thanks for a wonderful stay.

Kristen’s place is very nice and well kept. I had no issues whatsoever on the space itself. Great location and extremely clean.  Kristen is very strict on rules however.  I do understand that they have to protect their property but I felt like a kid at my mothers’ house. Way too many rules and are being watched by camera.  We were ‘scolded’ to leave the stoop at 10:30pm.  Haven’t seen my cousins in 5 years. If you know BedStuy, everyone is on the outside at night. We were not partying but chatting and having a great time.    Kristen could have pulled me to the side but angrily shouted at everyone as though we were 5. My husband and I have 7 houses and we rent them out. You have to allow people to live.  Paid guests felt uncomfortable and left at 3:30 am. I won’t be staying here again.  I hope Kristen now sees that her place was left in tact.  And she worries for no reason at all. “Never judge a book by its cover!”

Andrei went out of his way to make sure we had a comfortable stay in Prevelly. He emailed us a list of all the nearby bars, restaurants and shops etc. When we arrived at Driftwood Studio the place was immaculate. While we didn't even actually meet Andrei we we felt very welcome and very at home during our weekend away.

cozy spot to rest after a long day of traveling! the host is super kind and the fact that she lives next door can be helpful when you need something. we are super grateful with the flexibility of the check in and check out. pets are very welcome and there are amazing spots around in the nature to walk the dogs. beautiful garden from the house also! small inside space but more than enough to cook dinner and have a cup of tea on this rainy night. would recommend 100%!!

I loved staying here, the house was just perfect. I really loved how much thought they put into the place. I went for winter so having a heater even in the bathroom was a plus when you shower. The peacocks walking around was a treat.  I really appreciated them letting me check in a little earlier, saved me from hauling my luggage to places.

We truly enjoyed Ivy's place.  It was just as it looked in the photos, comfortable living room to gather, spacious dining room table to share breakfast, a bathroom on each of the 3 levels, and the location was excellent, a quick walk to the Marlebone underground.  Great place to stay.
Perfectly located and has everything you need, especially for a solo traveler! I will look forward to staying here again!

Great home in a great area. We used the ferry and it really made our trip easy.  The neighborhood is fantastic and we enjoyed two of the restaurants that were within walking distance. The taco place, Barracuda, was our favorite. The home itself is well maintained and clean. The bathtub is a little on the tall side, but it wasn’t an issue for us. We really enjoyed our stay.

Place was in the perfect location. Very close to a lot of restaurants and bars. I would recommend to take a pair of flip flops since the bathroom does not have a tub. If you are going in the winter months, Montreal gets A LOT of snow so it might be difficult to utilize the parking space in the back because of the accumulated snow (my boyfriend and I had to shovel ourself in which took about 15-20 minutes) other than that, host was nice and the place was clean (bed was nice and comfy)

Stella est le genre d'hôte qui m'incite clairement à choisir AirBnB plutôt qu'un hôtel. Elle nous a accueillis plus tôt que prévu et nous a indiqué à l'avance quelle ligne de métro prendre, quel ticket acheter etc. La chambre est hyper confortable et propre. On a même droit a un petit chocolat sur l'oreiller. Le quartier n'est pas "dingue" sauf si vous recherchez une vie de quartier à l'asiatique (on est en plein Chinatown) mais il est proche de toutes les attractions principales et au pire il y le tram/métro à proximité. Stella a toujours été aux petits soins avec nous et nous avons manqué de rien : un parapluie pour lutter contre le mauvais temps, un dentifrice qui a bien dépanné, une tisane avant d'aller se coucher etc. Un soir, elle  nous a même cuisiné un délicieux plat de Pizzoccheri. Stella est une personne très charmante et je garderai en mémoire très longtemps cette chouette rencontre.

Georgia was an excellent host - friendly, flexible, and accommodating. I could get a glass water, tea, pop, and/or coffee complimentary to my stay. The house was lovely! The room was beautiful, very quite, and super clean. The bathroom in the unit was the only thing that I thought about I might find it difficult to manage if I came there with a significant other because it didn't have a door, only a curtain (but for other people it might not be an issue). Since I came on my own, it was fine. The area was really nice and I felt super safe for a young women to walk outside at night. One of the best Airbnb experiences yet! Thank you so much!

The location of the studio can’t be better, the place is small but it has everything you need, besides being next to train, bicycle and bus stations, its surrounded by several restaurants of different type of food and convinience stores, Ali was an amazing host, he was really honest about the studio, and made sure that was exactly what we were looking for before accepting our reservation, i just highly recommend.

The only real issue we had was checking in. When we got there we found that details of the reservation had not been forwarded to the front desk of the resort. We had to wait for maybe half an hour and exchange several messages with Kelly before she got everything sorted out.  Once that was done, everything was great. The unit was extremely spacious, clean and comfortable. Amenities were great. We had a wonderful time and would love to come back.
Melody was super friendly and accommodating, especially since I booked it last minute. The place was absolutely beautiful and made the trip that much more enjoyable. I highly recommend staying here!

We had a lovely stay at Nikolaos’s place. It is a fabulous location! It is close to all the sights but you are able have a nice cool, quiet spot to watch the city. It is decorated beautifully and the roof top views are amazing!

The place was perfectly situated for everything in Lisbon.  Diogo went above and beyond making our stay comfortable.  his long list of things to do, restaurants, cafes, etc. were fantastically helpful.  And, when my daughter forgot an airbud, he arranged for it to be delivered to us at our next destination, Porto.  Exceptional!  Obrigadão, Diogo!

A estadia foi incrível. Apartamento cheio de amor, mais bonito do que nas fotos. Linda vista do mar e muito perto de tudo, ideal para quem gosta de aproveitar as festas da Lapa. O Leonardo foi muito atencioso e me recebeu com todo o carinho, sempre respondeu rapidamente a qualquer dúvida. Super recomendo
It was in a great location. Very close to downtown Asheville and it was nice to be at a place that allowed dogs.
Elena was super responsive and the apartment was in excellent condition and generously stocked. The location is perfect, would definitely recommend it.

Perfect location right on the sea! Panoramic views from almost every angle in the house! Very well equipped and comfortable house. We saw magnificent sunrises and sunsets each day. There is a fantastic sandy beach with very reasonable loungers and umbrellas as well as a cafe, just 5 minutes walk. The sea is great for swimming in. The supermarket has everything you may need and is a 3 minute walk. Nice quiet unpretentious family area. Short bus ride to Heraklion the capital of Crete. This was a most relaxing holiday ever and we can’t wait to come back. Thank you Zoe!
Clean comfortable place in a great location. Hosts were friendly, accommodating, and easy to contact. We hope to be able to use this place on future trips to Toronto.

Great place in Mexico’s Centro Historico. Close to everything we wanted to do, the apartment served its purpose. Thank you very much to Alice and her constant communication to ensure we were doing all right. We actually had an issue with the shower and once I told Alice the issue was fixed same day. Will definitely come back again!

The house is vers nice and clean and traditional. For the price, in santorini, it's a perfect place for those Who have a small budget. Emporio is a typical village and you feel live like the inhabitants and it's a feeling welcomed in such a tourist island. Don't miss Walking in this old and beautiful village. The village is well located in the middle of the island and the bus station is very closed if you don't have any car. Finally the father of our host Who lives upstairs was very frindly With us and our Child.
Great place in an excellent location, clean, comfortable and quiet. Within walking distance to anything you want to do while in downtown Nashville.

During our 4 day’s visit to Florence we opted to stay at Alexandro’s BnB and it was the perfect place we could have asked for. Hardly 5 minutes walk from Main Train Station, Bus & Train stands just outside the building and main city centre along with flee market, restaurants was there to explore :) It was worth every single penny we paid. Beautiful house, all amenities as mentioned in description and always available for help. The only issue we face was the door locks. There are 5 locks to get inside the flat and couple of the locks were little rusty. And the flat is on 3rd floor, so we had to use our muscles to carry all our luggage bags :D Apart from this everything was awesome. They even helped us to keep our bags on the day of checkout which was very helpful for us to visit Leaning tower of Pisa (55 minutes or train journey from Florence) I would surely visit Florence again and opt to stay at this property :) Ciao

O destaque fica por conta do anfitrião, muito atencioso e prestativo. A localização foi perfeita para nossa necessidade, muito próxima ao evento que fomos. As 5 pessoas ficaram bem acomodadas, considerando o tamanho do apartamento. As fotos mostram muito bem o local. Resumindo, voltaríamos lá com certeza. Porém, como crítica construtiva, vale anotar que a limpeza poderia ter sido mais caprichada, pois havia bastante poeira debaixo da cama, alguns cabelos e pelos no banheiro e a sacada estava bem empoeirada. Alguns retoques na pintua e outras pequenas intervenções deixariam o local ainda mais convidativo.
Orla was a brilliant, responsive host. We were very lucky to find this beautiful property. Thank you, Orla.

The location and value of this place is AWESOME. It's an older building and apartment but was immaculate and well taken care of. Check in was a breeze and communication was easy. There's a few places you can walk to including a bike share location. Downtown and the surround neighborhoods are easily accessible from here. I had a great stay, and even wanted to stay another night! This was a wonderful experience.

If you're reading this, you must be where I was before I went to Paris - nervous about choosing the right place in an unfamiliar city. Well, let me put your mind at ease; Imad's place is everything he says it is and more.  Its location is absolutely perfect. We walked to Trocadero, Eiffel Tower and the Sein River almost every day. The metro is like 100m away, there are ample bakeries, restaurants, fresh fruit and veg markets, boutique wine and formage shops in the neighbourhood.  Imad is an absolute gem of a host. He was quick to respond to our messages and he was very helpful with every aspect of our trip - from choosing taxies to bringing us coffee pods and freshly baked goods to organising a new set of keys at the drop of a hat when we locked ourselves out of his apartment (champagne brain).  Will I stay in his apartment again? Absolutely!  Should you stay in his apartment? Absolutely!

We were on an overnight trip to see a concert downtown.  The location was perfect, right by the downtown/Figueroa corridor bus stops and either a good walk or super cheap cab to Staples.  Obi was wonderful, he guided us in when we got a little lost and oriented us to his modern loft.  It's exactly as pictured and a bonus was the front patio - a glass and brick sectional that has a great urban vibe viewing the nearby cathedral, palm trees and LA street side.  Just totally cool. Apple TV kept the music flowing seamlessly.  He thought of little extras like breakfast snacks and bottled waters for our overnight stay.  Parking can be tough in downtown/USC but our parking arrangement worked out well with the provided daytime spot and easy street parking right in front of the loft at night. (note: you must move your car at 8am back to the day lot)  We went to school at SC and it's great to see the area blossoming with a nightlife and so many new modern housing complexes.  The occasional vagrant still coasts by like in any city, but the loft is quite secure and we had no issues.  Thanks for a great stay, we hope to be back!

If you can find a better experience I'd like to know about it, everything from the moment we arrived in Florence to when we left exceeded our expectations.  A short walk from the station, and from bus stops that take you all over the city, our stay was simply the best. Add in the engaging hospitality of Marco & Cristiana and the result is the best break you will ever have. Oh and I believe there might be one or two pieces of art thrown in as well!!
Great stay. Really enjoyed my short time in Brixton. Flat was extremely conveniently situated, clean & comfortable. An easy recommend & would definitely stay again.

Great location! Great Value!  Stacy was very helpful during our stay.  We enjoyed the courtyard and the bbq grill.  Plenty of street parking.  Will definitely rent Kelly's property again in the future!

Alloggio fantastico diviso tra spazi interni accoglienti e spazio esterno elegante. Ospitalità perfetta. Alberto ci ha addirittura offerto dei pasticcini in occasione della laurea della mia ragazza. Inoltre ci è stato concesso di rimanere per più ore oltre a quello prestabilito dal checkout. Consiglio questa sistemazione a famiglie numerose che hanno voglia di divertirsi insieme in un posto incantevole.
Amazing place Amazing owner and amazing property manager place looks exactly like in the pictures locations is amazing, everything is near by

We had a wonderful stay at Sean’s house! Everything was exactly as described and it’s a short walk to a very nice, family-friendly beach. The house was clean and very well stocked with kitchen items, beach towels, plenty of soap, etc. which was very convenient. He was very responsive and provided clear instructions and was easy to work with. There’s several restaurants nearby within walking distance and a little deli/market that has the basics (milk, bread, etc). The house is in a very cute and quiet residential neighborhood, but it’s only a few minutes drive from the boardwalk and main attractions in Santa Cruz. The trundle bed worked great for our 3 year old. The house was a good layout and a nice size for 3 adults and 2 toddlers. I would definitely recommend his place for families.

This flat was nice. We could access the Underground in just a few minutes to get around the city. We had plenty of space for our party of 3. The hosts were very responsive and kept in touch with us during our stay. Food delivery was easy for lazy evenings and there was a shop very close for essentials. We would definitely stay here again.
Great apartment - really big, airy and clean - and a brilliant location for exploring Vienna.  Eva is a great host - very responsive and super helpful.  Highly recommended!!

I stayed at Kris’s Airbnb with my boyfriend and his family. It was their first time in Texas, and I could not have picked a better place to stay. Kris was so responsive and kind, and his place exceeded all of our expectations! This is definitely where we’ll be staying every time we return to Texas in the future.

Luis has been reactive and full of attention during all our stay in Sevilla. His apartment is spacious and well-equiped. The terrace is a must ! 👍 The location is perfect: Quiet but only a few minutes walking to the Alameda area, which is perfect to hang out. A few minutes more to Las Setas and the historical center. And a few minutes in the other direction to get a bus direction Airport or Train station.

I expected it to be more remote, with more wildlife.  I heard chainsaws running most days.  Needed two wheelbarrow to get luggage 200 yards to the house. Since we have no choice except to cook for ourselves, the kitchen ought to be well stocked with tools and basics.  1/2 the utensils  rusty/filthy.  no basics beyond salt and pepper and a little oil. I was told to buy water, I bought two gallons.  There is a carboy with maybe a gallon in it that I could have used. The stove top needs to be unplugged when it randomly shuts off.  no oven, toaster or microwave.  No hot water, and no drinking water. no comfortable seating. 2 two metal folding chairs, and  a very uncomfortable wood bench, 1 hammock (not 2) & a floor lamp that shocks. staff/drivers are the good part but better to stay elsewhere and do excursions with someone responsive to issues. Waited 4 hours at the airport then 90 minutes to leave because adrienne thought it was cute to not inform me of a payment issue. do NOT recommend
A lovely little cottage that was peaceful and just what we were after for a relaxing place to stay while exploring the mountains. The two friendly horses in the paddock next door were also a delight!

Abigail followed up with me immediately upon my reservation and stayed in touch as our trip grew near.   Upon arrival, we found a kind greeting and a lovely home in great order with more amenities than expected. The neighborhood was very nice, quiet and well kept.  Convenient for a newcomer to Fort Worth... but as a long time Fort Worthian, I discovered a neighborhood that I didn't know much about.  Everything was nearby: museums, gardens, downtown, shopping... all right there.

We had a great time.  Good location. Unfortunately, the pool heater went out during our stay but we were told that might happen. There were only one wash cloths and hand towel when we arrived so we ended up having to buy washclosthes. John did reply quickly to any questions and concerns during out stay.   Our trip turned out very nice despite a couple of annoyances. I would recommend this place.
